actions.label: System Configuration Set up system parameters, eg. club address and email, and enable / disable certain features of the system.
Configure Timesheet Set up Tee Times and Tee Time Intervals for individual days, months and years.
Green Fee Rates Set up Green Fee Categories and Rates for Visitors, Societies, Member Guests, etc.
Reservation Types Set up the Reservation Types and choose their colours.
Booking Statuses Set up the Booking Statuses supported.
Payment Methods Set up the Payment Methods supported.
Contact Categories Set up the Contact Categories supported.
Catering / Refreshments Set up Catering and Refreshments.
No Show Reasons Set up reasons a player may not show for a booking.
Services Set up Services offered by the club such as Buggies, Caddies, Club Hire, Room Hire, Trolleys and Course Set Up.
Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees Copy Services, Catering or Green Fees from one year to another year.
Title for Each Day Set up a title for each day of the year which is displayed at the top of the timesheet pages.
Messages on the Timesheet Set up messages that get displayed on the timesheet.
Email and Letter Templates Set up a number of email and letter templates for sending to members and visitors, e.g. confirmation of booking, thank you message, etc.
Upload Timesheet Upload a timesheet for any given day including the player names and membership number.
Upload Members and Contacts Upload member and contact data files into the system.
Membership Types Set up membership types such as full, 6-day, 5-day, senior, junior, honorary and country members.
Legal Messages Set up Marketing Preferences, Privacy Policy, Member Terms and Conditions and Visitor Terms and Conditions.
Course Restriction Restrict course bookings to limited group sizes.
Email Messaging Send emails to your members and contacts.
Text Messaging Send text messages to your members and contacts.
Membership Groups for Messaging Set up membership groups and assign members to those groups.
Club News Create club news articles which can be viewed by members and the public.
Club Messages Send club messages to members who are using the BRS Members App or New Members Website.
Member Casual Booking Rules Set up the dates and times when members can view the timesheet and book casual golf on-line through the club website.
Member Competitions Set up competitions for members to book on-line through the club website.
Set this PC as Club House PC Set up / remove this PC as being Club House PC. This enables certain features within the club house.
Green Fee Rates for Visitors / Agents Set up green fee rates for visitors to book on-line through the club website. It is also for setting up rates for 3rd Party Tee Time Agents.
Day Ticket Rates for Visitors Set up green fee rates for visitors playing 2 rounds on the same day to book on-line through the club website.
Open Competitions for Visitors Set up open competitions for visitors to book on-line through the club website.
Golf Events Set up part of the timesheet for the organiser of an event to populate. This can be used for a member event, a corporate day etc.
Green Fee Rates for Tour Operator Set up green fee rates for tour operators to book on-line through the club website.
Process Competition Charges Process competition charges for each member.
Update Club Website Update Fixture List, Club News and Competition Reports on the club website. It also allows you to collect and manage member and visitor feedback.
Booking Payment Requests View the status of your Booking Payment Requests.
General Payment Requests View the status of your General Payment Requests.
Setup Use this tool to set up BRS Payments.
